opportunities.name: Sculpted rear and side-duct construction
opportunities.visible_gap: Current SC7 rear is a rounded slab with small central vent; side scoop reads as bright rectangular external frame.
opportunities.proposed_adaptation: Original rear shoulder, lamp/vent surrounds and lower valance that follow the body; tapered dark side duct with coherent boundary.

opportunities.name: Layered course verges
opportunities.visible_gap: Current Saltmarsh capture shows sparse isolated clumps, faceted shrubs and conical crowns.
opportunities.proposed_adaptation: Deterministic instanced verge clusters with varied green basal blades, warm seedheads and flower pockets; porous crown silhouettes; keep shoulders, aprons and bend sightlines clear.

opportunities.name: Personal improvement feedback
opportunities.visible_gap: Current circuit/practice HUD shows total time and progress but no personal lap/sector comparison.
opportunities.proposed_adaptation: Same-car best-run or lap feedback and a live comparison to the previous clean attempt. Timing/sector mechanics are an original adaptation of visible best-versus-current UI, not copied hidden logic.

implementation_mapping_scope.state: Implemented with successful latest combined-application TypeScript, 27-file lint and production build. The earlier seven-phase integration/physical gate, 63 Festival regressions, 26 selected assertions, component/HUD receipts and failed full-world attempt retain their original scopes.
implementation_mapping_scope.method: Read current production modules and map their concrete implementation to the actually observed image cues. Retain the complete earlier per-image observations, SHA-256 checks, dispositions, and proposed-opportunity record unchanged.
implementation_mapping_scope.mechanic_origin: The three-sector, same-car, same-session practice benchmark is our original adaptation of visible current-versus-best feedback and clear activity objectives; it is not a claim about hidden Forza timing or scoring implementation.
implementation_mapping_scope.publication_identity: The Git commit containing this ledger identifies publication; production source identity and scoped receipts are recorded in the revision document.
implementation_mapping_scope.component_scope_note: Car and failed-session reports retain their captured full-source identity; verge/HUD retain module and fixture hashes. All 81 Festival files, 156 core/simulation/lockfile inputs, and the physical runner remain unchanged through the last MotoGP integration. No final-source full-world browser pass is claimed.

implemented_mapping.observed_cue: Rear shoulders wrap the fascia; painted surfaces remain coherent around recessed lights, cooling openings, and exhaust structures.
implemented_mapping.implementation: RH3 and SC7 rearSweep parameters drive a shared rear deformation for body skin and attached trim/optics behind the rear tyre envelope. Adaptive curve refinement and inverse-transpose normal transport preserve the intended curved surface and reflections while the two cars retain their authored proportions. A true recessed registration mounting well, separately crowned lower bumper and fine bumper seam add rear panel hierarchy on both cars; RH3 also receives an authored hatch shut line.
implemented_mapping.limits: The sweep parameters, dimensions, and topology are authored for RH3 and SC7. These photos supply visible construction principles, not physics tuning or a measured reconstruction of either reference car.

implemented_mapping.observed_cue: Layered light structures sit within the rear body rather than reading as a flat stripe on its surface.
implemented_mapping.implementation: Both RH3 and SC7 receive two tapered lamp pockets cut through the actual rear cap and assembled with trim, recessed walls/backing, light guides, discrete optical cells, reverse-light segments, and a shared optical cover. The car-specific pockets follow each rear surface.
implemented_mapping.limits: The paired lamp outline and internal component dimensions are original choices, not a reproduction of a licensed vehicle design.

implemented_mapping.observed_cue: A tapered dark side duct is integrated with the curved flank and rear haunch.
implemented_mapping.implementation: The SC7 side intake now uses a tapered body opening, a surface-following reveal, deep inward throat, closed dark backing, and internal vanes in place of the raised square surround. Its rough dark liner avoids a mirror-like inner reflection.
implemented_mapping.limits: Reference images support depth and surface continuity, not measured duct dimensions or aerodynamic performance.

implemented_mapping.observed_cue: Low green growth, taller warm seedheads, irregular patches, and a readable clear driving surface produce layered road margins.
implemented_mapping.implementation: A deterministic meadow plan places short inner clumps and taller outer bands with shared patch gaps and varied tint. Shared opaque geometry has seventeen curved basal blades and two branched seedheads. Instanced 96 m chunks use distance fade, wind motion, and quality-dependent density. Roots sample the same carved 4 m terrain triangles as physics; full clump footprints keep clearance from roads, shoulders, junctions, buildings, and unsuitable terrain.
implemented_mapping.limits: 098 was reviewed only at contact-sheet scale in this pass and supports general foreground layering. New procedural clumps do not claim a botanically exact species or new flower asset. Existing repository photographic vegetation remains a separate optional presentation path; no reference image is imported as a texture.

implemented_mapping.observed_cue: Natural woodland edges have irregular, porous crowns and layered shrub silhouettes rather than isolated solid cones.
implemented_mapping.implementation: Festival conifer/shrub fallbacks use the existing foliage-card crown/atlas and shading systems. Broadleaf width-to-height ratios now select the broadleaf atlas instead of silently choosing the conifer tile; trunk/collision anchors remain the existing placement data.
implemented_mapping.limits: Species-selection correction and atlas reuse are technical implementation choices. The photos do not establish collision placement, density budgets, or performance.

implemented_mapping.observed_cue: 041/042 display current performance beside Current Best; 085 pairs named activities with a concise objective.
implemented_mapping.implementation: Solo one-lap four-wheel circuit practice measures three sectors from net legal route station, compares against one complete clean run for the same event and car in the current Festival session, and exposes a clear Retry loop. The HUD shows elapsed sectors/deltas and explicit invalidation reasons; results distinguish a clean benchmark from an unranked completion. Menu/map/photo modes suppress the practice display immediately.
implemented_mapping.limits: This timing mechanic is an original adaptation of the visible feedback principle. The images show drift-score feedback, not the three-sector circuit algorithm implemented here. Benchmarks are session-scoped and separate from existing saved event/career results. Weather preset and assists are fixed per session but weather/surface conditions may evolve; road validity tests the car centre including authored shoulders, not all four tyres against painted limits.
